product_one_liner.value: Multiplier acquires professional-services firms and builds custom AI and workflow technology to help their teams scale services such as tax and accounting.
product_one_liner.notes: The company description says it acquires and scales professional-services firms with AI and automation, and builds in-house AI and workflow components configured for each firm.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation and footer show portfolio, ideas, careers, about, contact, privacy, terms, and cookies links, but no pricing link. The pricing URL did not yield a pricing page.

named_customers.notes: The closest public example names Citrine International Tax, which is a portfolio firm, not a second qualifying customer. The homepage identifies portfolio companies rather than a customer list or case studies with at least two customer names; no two qualifying customers could be established.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 37 employees, which falls in the 21-50 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company profile gives the headquarters as Singapore, Singapore; the city is Singapore. | hq_country: The company profile gives its headquarters as Singapore, Singapore; the country is Singapore.

founded_year.notes: The company profile identifies Multiplier Holdings as founded in 2022.

eng_blog.notes: The ideas index lists strategy, talent, and career essays; the latest listed piece, “The Cathedral and the Casino,” is a strategy essay rather than an engineering account. The inspected index does not show two technical implementation posts by engineers.

public_docs.notes: The homepage navigation and footer contain no product documentation or help-center link. The checked docs and help addresses did not provide a public docs site.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open jobs board lists six positions, and none has AI, ML, data science, or a related term in its title.

model_provider.notes: The privacy policy mentions machine learning and generative AI without naming a model or provider; the terms refer generally to third-party AI services. The blog also discusses model providers generically rather than identifying one used by Multiplier. No specific provider is publicly identified in the reviewed material.

compliance_certs.notes: The legal pages do not claim SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, or PCI DSS certifications. The privacy policy references UK GDPR in the context of data-protection law and international data transfers, not as a certification. The list is therefore empty.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The funding record identifies the latest round as Series B. | funding_date: The latest funding record is dated 2026-08-04, so the requested YYYY-MM value is 2026-08. | funding_amount_usd: The funding record identifies the latest round as a Series B dated 2026-08-04 with an amount of USD 35,000,000.

raised_18mo.notes: The most recent round was a USD 35 million Series B in August 2026, within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers board includes a Sales & Business Development Associate role, but no title is SDR, BDR, business development representative, or account executive. Under the specified title criteria, this is false.

launched_6mo.notes: The company’s public launch announcement was June 18, 2025, before the six-month window. The later ideas index and September 2026 article contain strategy content, not a product or major-feature launch.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The August 4, 2026 announcement says Allen Shim joined Multiplier as President and CFO. That is a C-level appointment within the 12 months before November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The sales job description explicitly names HubSpot as the CRM to maintain and lists Streak and Apollo among tools candidates may be familiar with. The latter two are listed as examples rather than confirmed current systems. | crm_stack_signal.0: The job posting explicitly identifies HubSpot as the CRM to maintain. | crm_stack_signal.1: The posting lists Streak as an example of a CRM or related tool candidates may be familiar with. | crm_stack_signal.2: The posting lists Apollo as an example of a CRM or related tool candidates may be familiar with.
